items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Big Jones was at the corner

ctx.x: Now Tom, just in your own words about how you met Duke, in your association down through the years, please.

Well, I came to New York in '21, the last of November, and Robinson's restuarant was a big thing going then, at the corner of 131st Street and 7th Avenue, and all the performers used to go up there, see, and hang out there. Big Jones was at the corner, and Blackie's was around the corner there somewhere, and I'm in there playing the piano one night, and a guy said, "Here's Duke Ellington" and I kept on playing, and said, "Oh yeah?" and then they introduced me to Duke --and we became great friends through the…
